name: arthur_toxicity_benchmark
description: A dataset for evaluating toxicity detection models, containing text examples labeled for toxic or abusive content and related subcategories. It measures a model's ability to classify or flag harmful language and supports multi-label and binary toxicity evaluation. The benchmark is intended for moderation and safety research and tooling.
reputation: Used by practitioners for moderation evaluation and produced by an industry-focused provider; moderately recognized in applied toxicity detection contexts.
